  let g : α → β := λ x => if x = a then b else if f x = b then f a else f x
  have inj_g : Function.Injective g :=
    by
      intro x y hxy
      by_cases hx : x = a
      by_cases hy : y = a
      · -- x = a, y = a
        rw [hx, hy]
        rfl
      · -- x = a, y ≠ a
        have gx_eq_b : g x = b := by simp [hx]
        have gy : g y = (if f y = b then f a else f y) := by simp [hy]

          have b_eq_fa : b = f a := by rw [hxy]; exact hfy ▸ rfl
          have y_eq_a : y = a := f.Injective.eq (by rw [← b_eq_fa, hfy])
          contradiction
        · -- f y ≠ b
          have f_y_eq_b : f y = b := by rw [hxy]; exact hfy
          exact hfy f_y_eq_b
      · -- x ≠ a, y = a
        have gy_eq_b : g y = b := by simp [hy]
        have gx : g x = (if f x = b then f a else f x) := by simp [hx]
        rw [gy_eq_b, gx] at hxy
        by_cases hfx : f x = b
        · -- f x = b
          have b_eq_fa : b = f a := by rw [hxy]; exact hfx ▸ rfl
          have x_eq_a : x = a := f.Injective.eq (by rw [← b_eq_fa, hfx])
          contradiction
        · -- f x ≠ b
          have f_x_eq_b : f x = b := by rw [hxy]; exact hfx
          exact hfx f_x_eq_b
      · -- x ≠ a, y ≠ a
        have gx : g x = (if f x = b then f a else f x) := by simp [hx]
        have gy : g y = (if f y = b then f a else f y) := by simp [hy]
        rw [gx, gy] at hxy
